newsitem.title: USA: Run cuts still seen at Tosco Calif. refinery.
newsitem.headline: Run cuts still seen at Tosco Calif. refinery.

text.p: Tosco Corp continues to cut crude oil runs at its 170,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Avon, Calif., a trader familiar with plant operations said Friday.
The company cut the refinery's intake of crude oil by 10,000 barrels-per-day on October 28.
The trader could not say when throughput would fully resume, but said cuts would end once refinery margins improve.
"We're waiting for products to come back and then we'll stop run cuts," he added.
Analysts said earlier that fourth quarter margins out west have fallen 21 percent from the previous quarter.

Tosco Corp owns four U.S. refineries, with two on the East Coast, and two out west. The company operates a network of 4,000 retail stores - including a chain of 2,500 Circle K convenience stores acquired in 1996 for $700 million.
